lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਾਣ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau lag jeeu paraan sach dhiaaeeai ||
lines.translation: As long as there is the breath of life, meditate on the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: laahaa har gun gaai milai sukh paaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You shall receive the profit of singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and find peace. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਾਰ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਤੂੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachee teree kaar dehi daiaal too(n) ||
lines.translation: True is Your Service; bless me with it, O Merciful Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਮੈ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਤੂੰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: hau jeevaa tudh saalaahi mai tek adhaar too(n) ||2||
lines.translation: I live by praising You; You are my Anchor and Support. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਰਵਾਨੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dar sevak daravaan darad too(n) jaanahee ||
lines.translation: I am Your servant, the gate-keeper at Your Gate; You alone know my pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੈਰਾਨੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat teree hairaan darad gavaavahee ||3||
lines.translation: How wonderful is Your devotional worship! It removes all pains. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: daragah naam hadoor guramukh jaanasee ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs know that by chanting the Naam, they shall dwell in His Court, in His Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੇਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਸੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: velaa sach paravaan sabad pachhaanasee ||4||
lines.translation: True and acceptable is that time, when one recognizes the Word of the Shabad. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਤੋਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh kar bhaau tosaa har naam sei ||
lines.translation: Those who practice Truth, contentment and love, obtain the supplies of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਹੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: manahu chhod vikaar sachaa sach dei ||5||
lines.translation: So banish corruption from your mind, and the True One will grant you Truth. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਸਚੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sache sachaa nehu sachai laaiaa ||
lines.translation: The True Lord inspires true love in the truthful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਆਉ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: aape kare niaau jo tis bhaaiaa ||6||
lines.translation: He Himself administers justice, as it pleases His Will. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sache sachee daat dehi daiaal hai ||
lines.translation: True is the gift of the True, Compassionate Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: tis sevee din raat naam amol hai ||7||
lines.translation: Day and night, I serve the One whose Name is priceless. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਉਤਮੁ ਹਉ ਨੀਚੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕਾਂਢੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) utam hau neech sevak kaa(n)dheeaa ||
lines.translation: You are so sublime, and I am so lowly, but I am called Your slave.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਂਢੀਆ ॥੮॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nadar karehu milai sach vaa(n)dheeaa ||8||21||
lines.translation: Please, shower Nanak with Your Glance of Grace, that he, the separated one, may merge with You again, O Lord. ||8||21||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaanaa kiu rahai kiu melaa hoee ||
lines.translation: How can coming and going, the cycle of reincarnation be ended? And how can one meet the Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਨਿਤ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran kaa dukh ghano nit sahasaa doee ||1||
lines.translation: The pain of birth and death is so great, in constant skepticism and duality. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਫਿਟੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai kiaa jeevanaa phit dhrig chaturaaee ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, what is life? Cleverness is detestable and cursed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur saadh na seviaa har bhagat na bhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: One who does not serve the Holy True Guru, is not pleased by devotion to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਤਉ ਰਹੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaavan tau rahai paaeeai gur pooraa ||
lines.translation: Coming and going is ended only when one finds the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਦੇਇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕੂਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam dhan raas dei binasai bhram kooraa ||2||
lines.translation: He gives the wealth and capital of the Lord's Name, and false doubt is destroyed. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janaa kau mil rahai dhan dhan jas gaae ||
lines.translation: Joining the humble Saintly beings, let us sing the blessed, blessed Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aad purakh apara(n)paraa guramukh har paae ||3||
lines.translation: The Primal Lord, the Infinite, is obtained by the Gurmukh. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਟੂਐ ਸਾਂਗੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਬਾਜੀ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: natooai saa(n)g banaaiaa baajee sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: The drama of the world is staged like the show of a buffoon.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਉਝਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: khin pal baajee dekheeai ujharat nahee baaraa ||4||
lines.translation: For an instant, for a moment, the show is seen, but it disappears in no time at all. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਖੇਲਣਾ ਝੂਠੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai chaupaR khelanaa jhoothe aha(n)kaaraa ||
lines.translation: The game of chance is played on the board of egotism, with the pieces of falsehood and ego.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹਾਰੈ ਸੋ ਜਿਣੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sabh jag haarai so jinai gurasabad veechaaraa ||5||
lines.translation: The whole world loses; he alone wins, who reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਹਥਿ ਟੋਹਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu a(n)dhulai hath tohanee har naam hamaarai ||
lines.translation: As is the cane in the hand of the blind man, so is the Lord's Name for me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਦਉਤ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam har tek hai nis daut savaarai ||6||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is my Support, night and day and morning. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu too(n) raakhahi tiu rahaa har naam adhaaraa ||
lines.translation: As You keep me, Lord, I live; the Lord's Name is my only Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t sakhaaee paaiaa jan mukat duaaraa ||7||
lines.translation: It is my only comfort in the end; the gate of salvation is found by His humble servants. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran dukh metiaa jap naam muraare ||
lines.translation: The pain of birth and death is removed, by chanting and meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na veesarai pooraa gur taare ||8||22||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who does not forget the Naam, is saved by the Perfect Guru. ||8||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 asatapadeeaa ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਚਰਣ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saasat bed si(n)mrit sar teraa surasaree charan samaanee ||
lines.translation: The Shaastras, the Vedas and the Simritees are contained in the ocean of Your Name; the River Ganges is held in Your Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਖਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਮਤਿ ਰਾਵੈ ਤੂੰ ਤਾਂ ਸਰਬ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saakhaa teen mool mat raavai too(n) taa(n) sarab vidaanee ||1||
lines.translation: The intellect can understand the world of the three modes, but You, O Primal Lord, are totally astounding. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa ke charan japai jan naanak bole a(n)mrit baanee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on His Feet, and chants the Ambrosial Word of His Bani. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਤੀਸ ਕਰੋੜੀ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tetees karoRee daas tumhaare ridh sidh praan adhaaree ||
lines.translation: Three hundred thirty million gods are Your servants. You bestow wealth, and the supernatural powers of the Siddhas; You are the Support of the breath of life.
